build_actor_model: build a FullyConnected actor model with custom layer sizes and activations for continuous action spaces
create_fully_connected_net_builder: create a FullyConnected net builder instance with default 128-64 layer sizes and relu activations
configure_batch_norm: configure the FullyConnected net builder to use batch normalization in the actor network
set_exploration_variance: set the exploration variance parameter on the FullyConnected net builder for stochastic action sampling
validate_sizes_activations: validate that the FullyConnected net builder has matching sizes and activations lists during initialization
